usage: 半杯 is used to refer to half of a cup in volume measurements.
It can describe quantities of liquids or small granular materials.
When ordering or cooking, 半杯 helps specify the amount precisely.
It can be combined with other quantities to describe recipes or servings.
半杯 often appears in everyday conversations when measuring drinks or ingredients.
